remarks: Wake up to beautiful morning sunrises in this bright and airy 1-bedroom, 1-bath condo on the 9th floor, offering over 800 sqft of spacious living with the building's largest 1BR layout. The open floor plan is designed for modern living and entertaining, with expansive wall-to-wall windows that fill the space with natural light. The modern kitchen features stainless steel appliances, granite countertops, and a breakfast bar. The generously sized bedroom includes a custom walk-in closet and offers ample space for a home office. For added convenience and comfort, the unit also has a double-entry bathroom and an in-unit washer and dryer. Freshly painted throughout with removed popcorn ceilings, recessed lighting, and plenty of room to add your own personal touch. Located in The Biltmore, a premier high-rise condominium, residents enjoy a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, shuttle service, community room, laundry room, storage, 4th-flr courtyard, dry cleaning, and a pet-friendly environment. Secure garage parking is available for $115/mo per car. Conveniently located near I-95, Metro-North, Merritt Parkway, and just steps from the vibrant Bedford Street and Pickleball America, one of the largest indoor pickleball venues in the US, this condo offers the best of city living in the heart of Stamford!
